item.title: Fixing Bugs in CPython #1: A Use-After-Free in Context.__eq__
item.description: How comparing two contextvars.Context objects could crash the Python interpreter, and how the fix works. First in a series for anyone who wants to understand the CPython codebase or make their first contribution to it.
